chapter: Sideman years: J.J., Tyree Glenn, Sweets
title: Knowing Monk and hearing Coltrane at the Five Spot
summary: He had listened at the Five Spot to Monk with Wilbur Ware and Shadow Wilson, and first heard Coltrane there.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: Had you met Monk before this?
Oh yeah I used to go by the 5 spot where he played there for a long time. When Wilbur Ware and Shadow Wilson were playing with him I used to go by there and talk

with Shadow during the intermissions. And Wilbur, I knew him very well from Chicago. It was just—I lived only two blocks away so I would walk over there every night. I’d get a seat, buy a bottle of beer, and listen to the music.
So you already knew—you were familiar with his music so you didn’t have any apprehensions about playing Monk’s music?
No. I mean Coltrane was working with him during that period. So that was the first time I heard Coltrane play.
